console.name: sql-query
console.title: SQL Query
console.description: Execute SQL queries on DataSource beans

columnValues.label: query
columnValues.description: Changed column-value pairs as JSON string for update-row action

datasource.label: query
datasource.description: Name of the DataSource bean in the registry (auto-detected if only one exists)

maxRows.label: query
maxRows.description: Maximum number of rows to return

primaryKeyValues.label: query
primaryKeyValues.description: Primary key column-value pairs as JSON string for update-row action

status.description: The execution status, success or error

message.description: The error message (only present on error)

datasource.description: The resolved DataSource bean name (only present once resolved)

availableDataSources.description: The available DataSource bean names (only present when multiple exist and none was specified)

elapsed.description: Elapsed time in milliseconds (only present once a query attempt was made)

primaryKey.description: Whether the column is part of the primary key (only present when the query targets a single, editable table)

columns.description: The result set columns (only present for queries returning a result set)

rows.description: The result set rows, one opaque JSON object per row (only present for queries returning a result set)

rowCount.description: Number of rows returned (only present for queries returning a result set)

truncated.description: Whether the result set was truncated by maxRows (only present for queries returning a result set)

updateCount.description: Number of rows affected (only present for queries/updates not returning a result set)

tableName.description: The single table the result set maps to (only present when the result is a single, editable table)

primaryKeys.description: The primary key column names (only present when the result is a single, editable table)

editable.description: Whether the result set rows can be edited (only present when true)
